distinctness.reason: The political sense concerns basic governmental rules, powers and limits. Material constitution is the philosophical puzzle about an object and its constituting matter, illustrated by a statue and clay. These are different meanings.

evidence.locator: What is a skin graft?; Risks—graft take
evidence.note: A graft moves detached skin to a wound; new vessels support graft take, which can fail.

distinctness.reason: Horticultural grafting joins plant scion and rootstock. Skin grafting transfers detached skin that must establish a blood supply. These are separate procedures and learning identities.

evidence.note: Algebraic groups distinguish cycles that bound regions from cycles detecting holes in a space.
Tetrapod forelimbs are homologous; bird and bat wings are analogous as wings.

distinctness.reason: Biological homology concerns inherited correspondence through common ancestry. Mathematical homology uses algebraic objects to describe cycles and boundaries. Shared wording does not establish equivalence.
